reference: The water is cold, so you should wear boots.
sk: Voda je studená, mal by si si obuť čižmy.
cz: Voda je studená, měl bys si obout holínky.
acceptable: The water is cold, {so|} you should {wear|put on} {boots|rubber boots|rain boots|wellies|wellingtons}.

mistakes.text: The water is cold, so you should to wear boots.
The water is cold, so you must wear boots.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Tu ide o radu, patrí „should“, nie „must“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Tady jde o radu, patří „should“, ne „must“.

mistakes.text: The water is cold, so you should wearing boots.
The water is cold, so you should put boots.
The water is cold, so you had better wear boots.

source_issues: Slovak 'čižmy' means boots, Czech 'holínky' means rubber boots; both accepted. Native sentences have no 'so'.
